name: Notre Dame Intermedica Participacoes S.A.
summary: Notre Dame Intermédica Participações S.A. provides preventive medicine programs in Brazil. The company offers preventive medicine programs for pregnant women and the elderly, as well as the cases of patients with chronic diseases, such as hypertension, diabetes, obesity, spine problems, asthma, bronchitis, and heart diseases. It also provides health, dental, and occupational health plans. The company was formerly known as BCBH Participações S.A. and changed its name to Notre Dame Intermédica Participações S.A. on April 25, 2017. Notre Dame Intermédica Participações S.A. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
